name: User registration without tenant information leaves user unassigned
expected: No default Acme fallback; status defaults to pending_onboarding
details: Trigger handle_new_user() leaves users without verified tenant context in pending_onboarding state

name: Forged user_metadata.tenant_id is ignored
details: Trigger only evaluates server-signed raw_app_meta_data for initial tenant assignment

name: Invitation-based tenant assignment creates verified membership
expected: Valid tenant enrollment automatically creates public.memberships record
details: Verified server-set tenant writes to both profiles and memberships join table

name: Suspended account rejected by is_tenant_member()
details: PostgreSQL RLS function verifies user profile status is active before evaluating access

name: Disabled/Suspended accounts rejected at API perimeter
expected: getVerifiedAuthContext() returns unauthorizedResult if profile.status != active
details: Server auth authority rejects inactive/suspended profiles before route execution

name: Revoking membership removes RLS authorization immediately
expected: is_tenant_member() requires row in public.memberships; profiles.tenant_id cannot bypass
details: Membership row deletion immediately terminates database authorization

name: Stale profile tenant_id cannot restore revoked access
expected: No fallback to profile.tenant_id when membership is missing in memberships table
actual: Strictly checks memberships list in both auth and switch routes
details: Server context and workspace switch verify explicit memberships only

name: Cross-tenant media download rejected with HTTP 403
expected: GET /api/media/download rejects users without membership in the target tenant prefix
actual: Validates caller membership against key prefix before signing
details: Authenticated download route enforces tenant membership on file key prefix

name: Unauthenticated media download rejected with HTTP 401
details: Media download requires cryptographically verified Supabase session

name: Private bucket configured in migration 012 and bootstrap plan
expected: community-media bucket configured with public = false; public read policies removed
actual: public = false enforced in migration 012 and bootstrap specification
details: Bootstrap scripts mandate private bucket configuration for community-media
